label: TP
reason: Alert 1 is a True Positive. The flow traces user input from `theCookie.getValue()` (line 76) -> `param` (line 76) -> `bar` (line 82) -> `input` (line 109) -> `new String(...)` (line 109) -> `encodeForHTML(...)` (line 105) -> sink string concatenation (lines 104-110). Although `encodeForHTML` sanitizes XSS characters, the raw user-supplied value flows directly into the response stream via `response.getWriter().println()`. The resolved sink value depends entirely on the attacker-controlled `param` variable derived from `theCookie.getValue()`, making this a real XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: User input from Cookie value flows through param->bar->input->encoded string to response.getWriter().println()
